questions.question: After King Rehoboam of Judah became strong and established his rule, what did he and all Israel do?

answers.text: Forsook the Law of the LORD

questions.question: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam's reign, King Shishak attacked Jerusalem. Which country was he king of?
When Shishak attacked Jerusalem, what did the prophet Shemaiah say the LORD told King Rehoboam and Judah's leaders?

answers.text: Because you left Me I have handed you over to Shishak
Stand firm and I will drive Shishak out
Send gold and Shishak will turn back

questions.question: When King Rehoboam and the leaders of Judah humbled themselves before the LORD, what did the LORD say He would do?

answers.text: He would scatter them among the nations
